rows.label: Subprocessor or affiliate information
Fill in for each subprocessor / affiliate

Subprocessor or affiliate name as provided in the TOM questionnaire #8.3.
(Please add the full name and legal form of the sub-processor)

"Contact details of sub-processor”: please add the full address of the sub-processor and, if the sub-processor has a representative (Article 27 GDPR), please add the name and the full address of the representative.

“Contact details of the sub-processor’s data protection officer”: if the sub-processor has a data protection officer, please add the data protection officer’s name, telephone number and/or email address. If the sub-processor has no data protection officer, please insert N/A and add instead a telephone number and/or email address where the sub-processor (i.e. of a contact of the sub-processor who is entitled to respond to data protection-related requests of SAP) can be reached into the contact details of sub-processor column.

“Processing operations of sub-processor”: please describe the concrete data processing services each sub-processor is performing (i.e. which categories of personal data of SAP and its customers are processed to which extent. Processing of personal data means any operation or set of operations which is performed on personal data or on sets of personal data, whether or not by automated means, such as collection, recording, organization, structuring, storage, adaptation or alteration, retrieval, consultation, use, disclosure by transmission, dissemination or otherwise making available (which includes the mere access to systems containing personal data while providing support), alignment or combination, restriction, erasure or destruction).

“Level”: please add the level on which the relevant sub-processor processes SAP and its customers’ personal data. Level 1 would mean a direct sub-processor of your entity, Level 2 a sub-processor of your direct sub-processor, etc. Please provide this information throughout the whole data processing chain.

Please provide the following additional information regarding your sub-processors. - Do you enter into "sub-processing data protection agreements" with your sub-processors which content-wise mirror the terms of the SAP Master Data Processing Agreement (MDPA) / SAP Contractor Agreement on the Commissioned Processing of Personal Data (CDPA) between SAP and your company?
Did your sub-processors actually implement the technical and organizational measures (TOM) set out on these sub-processing data protection agreements?
Please describe any deficiencies (“Gaps”)
Please let us know the “Remediation plan” until when your company will have closed each gap.
Do you "audit" your sub-processors’ compliance with the terms of these sub-processing data protection agreements including the agreed technical and organizational measures (TOM)?
If Yes, i.e., audits are conducted - “By way of which means?” how these audits are conducted by selecting the accurate response per sub-processor.
If Yes, i.e., audits are conducted - which “evidence” is your company creating regarding audits per sub-processor? Please attach the respective evidence.
If Yes, i.e., audits are conducted - Did any of these audits reveal findings?
If Yes, i.e., audit findings were revealed - Describe each "audit finding" relating to each sub-processor
If Yes, i.e., audit findings were revealed - Please describe “Actions taken” (what did each sub-processor do in order to remedy each of the findings).
If Yes, i.e., audit findings were revealed - Please let us know for each finding whether it has been "remedied"
If Yes, i.e., audit findings were revealed but not remediated - please let us know until when each your sub-processors will have remedied the respective finding.
Have there been any "incidents" caused by or in connection with the usage of sub-processors within the last year?
If Yes, i.e., incidents were caused - Describe each incident (including the affected personal data categories of SAP and/or its customers)
If Yes, i.e., incidents were caused - Please describe “Actions taken” (what did each sub-processor do in order to remedy each of the incidents)
If Yes, i.e., incident were caused - Please let us know for each incident whether it has been "remedied"
If Yes, i.e., incident were caused but not remediated - please let us know until when each of your sub-processor will have remedied the respective incident.
